evidence: Microstructures of the ALD Fe xCo1−xSy films were examined by transmission electron microscopy (TEM). The surface morphology of the ALD Fe xCo1−xSy films was examined by scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and atomic force microscopy (AFM). The purity of the ALD Fe xCo1−xSy films was examined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS). Raman spectra were also taken on these films. Electrochemical impedance spectra (EIS) were also taken for the Fe xCo1−xSy films. Cyclic voltammetry in the non-Faradaic regime was used to measure the electrical double-layer capacitance.
